speaker: charlie
text: Science corner now, and this one's for anyone with an old solar panel gathering dust in the shed. Aussie researchers are getting properly good at recycling solar panels, pulling the silicon and metals back out instead of them ending up in landfill.

speaker: alice
text: It's such a simple idea done properly, we've been so focused on putting panels up that nobody really planned for what happens when they wear out. Turning old panels into new ones is exactly the kind of boring, brilliant science that actually matters.

speaker: charlie
text: Boring and brilliant, that's basically the ParkSyde motto. Good on the boffins, keep at it.
